verdict.rationale: Gumroad is a creator e-commerce platform that could plausibly ship an in-product AI assistant, so this story applies. The evidence pack shows no built-in assistant that users can delegate tasks to. The OAuth + MCP item covers external agents connecting to Gumroad, which is a different story. The AI support chatbots and OpenAI/Helper.ai vendor mentions concern customer support and moderation, not user task delegation.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product
